slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

night sky minutes

lie down and look at the night sky for 10 minutes, no phone. feeling tiny for a moment makes every embarrassing thing you're carrying shrink with it.

small opinions

share one honest opinion a day in a group, even a small one about a movie. people who say what they think, kindly, become the people others trust.

recipe free cooking

cook one meal a week without a recipe video. trusting your own hands to figure it out spills into everything else.

one painting a day

look at one painting a day for 5 minutes and learn its story. you train your eye and your patience, and you end up with stories nobody else in the room knows.
slides.texte_sophia:
one painting a day

look at one painting a day and learn its story. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app does it in 5 minutes, and you end up with stories nobody else in the room knows.

slides.texte_overlay:
letters to next year

every sunday, write a few lines to yourself one year from now. you start acting like someone with a future worth reporting back to.
